provenance.what: PaddleX's text detector run alone on frozen Python's working image of each of the 13 stored bay photos
provenance.recorded_by: M29 P4, a scratch script: preprocess.py's load_image, find_screen_quad, warp_to_rect, _resize and enhance, then the live OCR pipeline's text_det_model (PaddleOCR as paddle.py constructs it, oneDNN off) with get_text_det_params()
provenance.versions: paddleocr 3.7.0, paddlex 3.7.2, paddlepaddle 3.3.1, opencv 4.10.0, pyclipper 1.4.0, numpy 2.3.5
provenance.quad: screen_quads.json's quad, which the working image was cut by; null where the photo is read uncropped
provenance.working: the working image's width and height; it is screen_working.json's enhanced image, checked by digest
provenance.x_sha256: SHA-256 of the detector's input tensor, f32 little-endian, NCHW
provenance.boxes: dt_polys in the detector's own order, each four [x, y] corners in the working image's pixels
provenance.scores: dt_scores, cv2.mean with IPP on (OpenCV's default); with IPP off every box and score on every photo was the same
provenance.sorted: the boxes after the OCR pipeline's SortQuadBoxes
